results.title: Reminder home: due summary count + due section; two water-now taps decrement 3 -> 1 (still shows the AFTER state)

vision.notes: Dark-green summary banner «Сьогодні полити» shows the count «1» (the AFTER state after decrement), and the «ПОТРЕБУЮТЬ ПОЛИВУ» due-reminders section renders one card («Демо: Скоро полити») with a green water-now droplet button — proving the due-summary count, due section, and post-water-now decremented state. Text is legible throughout: high-contrast white-on-dark-green banner, dark text on cream cards, and clear status badges («Здорова», «Скоро полив»). Note: this is a single AFTER still, so the 3->1 transition itself is not shown in one frame, but the requirement's stated end state (count=1) is correctly displayed.

results.title: Plant CRUD: add -> open detail -> edit -> back to list (still shows the new plant card present)

vision.notes: The list view «Мої рослини» renders fully with the newly added plant card titled «Демо-запис рослини 1782807867966 (оновлено)» — the «(оновлено)» / edited suffix visibly proves the edit was saved, and the card persisting back in the list proves create + list-persistence. The only minor gap: this single still cannot show the intermediate «open detail view» step itself, but the edited-and-persisted card is strong evidence of the full flow's outcome.

results.title: Charts: growth + watering Recharts SVGs render on a seeded plant

vision.notes: Both Recharts SVGs render with real data: top «Графік росту рослини» shows a green growth curve rising from ~9cm to ~37cm across 31.05–30.06.2026 with three plotted points, and bottom «Графік поливів рослини» shows a brown watering line at level 1 across 19.06–30.06.2026 with three markers. Axis labels (Висота (см), Поливів за день), tick values, and dates are all legible; titles are dark olive on a light cream background with adequate contrast. No spinners, empty states, or clipping observed.

results.title: Design system: «Поливайко» paper-theme home, brand wordmark, cards, status pills

vision.notes: All four design-system elements are visibly rendered: green water-drop «Поливайко» wordmark in the cream paper-theme header, card components (dark-green «Сьогодні полити» hero card, white plant cards with thumbnails, bottom media card), and status pills/labels («Прострочено на 1 дн.», «Полити сьогодні», a rounded «Потребує поливу» pill with red dot, «Потрібно полити»). Text is legible with good contrast (dark text on cream/white, white on dark green). Minor: the hero and plant cards are clipped at the right viewport edge indicating horizontal overflow — fix the container width/padding so cards fit, but it does not block the requirement.

results.title: Responsive: home is usable at 360px with no horizontal overflow

vision.notes: At 360px the «Поливайко» home screen renders cleanly: header with logo + «Рослини» nav, «Мої рослини» title, green «Додати рослину» button, a dark stat card («Сьогодні полити 2»), and a vertical stack of full-width plant cards with images, status pills (Здорова/Потребує поливу), dates, and action buttons (Полити зараз, Доглянути). Content fits the viewport with consistent side margins and no horizontal overflow; all text (titles, italic species names, status labels) is legible with good contrast. Usable and legible — NFR-COMPAT-01 satisfied.
